messages:
Morgan: Heads up — code freeze for 1.8 starts in ~6h (00:00 UTC). If you need a late merge, post PR link + brief risk note.
release-bot: Code freeze window scheduled: 2026-11-02T00:00Z → 2026-11-04T06:00Z. Exceptions need release manager approval + green smoke tests.
Jen: Need a late merge for a small revert that stops logging spam in emb-runtime. PR #5128. Low risk.
Kyle: Can you paste the PR? Also does this change any DB migrations or public API?
Jen: PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/5128 — revert of a noisy WARN in init path. No schema or API changes.
Sam: I can review in ~20m. @Morgan tagging for release policy check.
Morgan: If it's just a revert of internal log line and CI passes, I'm inclined to allow. Must include a changelog entry and a short test. Also paste the cherry-pick command you'll use.
Jen: Cherry-pick command: `git checkout release/1.8.0 && git cherry-pick -x abc1234`
Kyle: One ask — make sure we don't invalidate any perf checks. That log line was added in rc1; quick perf smoke would be good.
Sam: Quick review notes: LGTM with 1 nit. Ran unit tests locally; one flaky db-test failed but unrelated. Re-triggering CI now.
ops-bot: CI queued: test-suite, smoke-perf, integration.
Sara: Quick question — do we want this in changelog under 'fix' or 'chore'? I'd mark as `fix` because it affects prod noise.
Jen: Added `fix: reduce logging noise in emb-runtime` to changelog and a tiny unit that asserts the WARN is gone on startup. Pushed.
release-bot: CI: all checks passed for PR #5128 — smoke-perf within baseline.
Morgan: Thanks. Approving late-merge conditionally: (1) CI green, (2) changelog present, (3) test added. I'll merge and monitor staging for 30 minutes. Tagging @Sara for final sign-off.
Sara: I reviewed tests and changelog. OK to merge.
Jen: Merging now. Will watch logs.
ops-bot: Deploy-preview to staging started.
Sam: Monitoring staging logs — looks clean so far. No new WARNs.
Morgan: All good at +10m. If no regressions by +30m, we'll keep in release. Thanks for the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
release-bot: Merged PR #5128 into `release/1.8.0` by Jen. Merge run: https://ci.redwood/merge/5128
Jen: Thanks everyone!
Sam: Nice work :rocket:
Morgan: Closing thread — file final note in release checklist doc about this exception.
